name: Detonation: Pulsating (Ea = 27)
blurb: The same detonation with Ea = 27, past the neutral stability of Ea = 25.26: the lead shock pulses, its pressure swinging above and below the ZND spike of 42.1. The pulsations need a well-resolved reaction zone, a few tens of cells per half-reaction length, or they damp out (Henrick, Aslam & Powers 2006).
